purpose: Determine why productive Objective Semantics v2 operators lose observed productivity between replicated medium and authoritative target-scale inputs.

selected_operators.reason: The fixed-cycle medium artifacts show this family accounts for the dominant repeated gains in all three scenario families, including the large special-commitment-pressure descent. It is also the first fixed-cycle operator attempted at target scale, so it directly tests the medium-to-target crossover.

not_selected_second_operator.reason: It contributes a smaller follow-on utilization step after targeted_r4_s2 in the medium fixed-cycle trajectories. Existing artifacts do not require a second expensive target operator to explain the dominant medium advantage; it remains reference evidence only.

artifact_first_protocol.existing_medium_artifacts: Use without rerun for fixed-cycle forensics.
artifact_first_protocol.existing_target_artifacts: Use without rerun for target attempt forensics.

target_worker_gate.interpretation: A candidate counts only after unchanged full-model validation. UNKNOWN is unresolved and never evidence of infeasibility or optimality. The worker-count comparison is diagnostic only and does not select a production worker configuration.

replication_gate.seed_202_or_303: Run only if the seed-101 worker comparison is decision-relevant under the preregistered evidence rules.
replication_gate.longer_horizon: Run at most one longer seed-101 cell only if both worker counts are unresolved, CP-SAT reached genuine search, the process was resource healthy, and the prior horizon is plausibly too short.

artifact_first_findings.medium_conclusion: targeted_r4_s2 accounts for the dominant observed gain in every fixed-cycle medium family. The utilization operator is a smaller follow-on contributor. Seeds 202 and 303 converge to the same endpoint in all three families, although the special-pressure adoption sequences are not identical.
artifact_first_findings.target_artifact_conclusion: Fixed-cycle target artifacts reached the same two operator families as the medium sequence, including targeted_r4_s2, but every one-worker target attempt ended UNKNOWN with zero branches and zero conflicts before candidate validation. The artifacts do not establish infeasibility or optimality.
artifact_first_findings.scale_crossover_interpretation: The stored evidence is consistent with a target-scale setup/presolve/search-start bottleneck rather than proof that the operator family cannot improve the target. The new matched worker gate is required to test worker throughput, but the zero-branch result means a longer horizon is not justified by the preregistered rule unless a future run demonstrates genuine search.

final_classification.worker_count_effect: not_demonstrated; one and eight workers both stopped before genuine branch search
final_classification.replications: not_run because the seed-101 comparison was not decision-relevant under the gate
final_classification.longer_horizon: not_run because neither cell demonstrated genuine CP-SAT search
